segments.text:
V. 39.
And one of the malefactors reviled him—St. Matthew ſays, the robbers; St. Mark, they that were crucified with him, reviled him. Either therefore St. Matthew and Mark put the Plural for the Singular (as the beſt Authors ſometimes do) or both reviled Him at the firſt, till one of them felt "the overwhelming Power of ſaying Grace."
